hero.title: About Us
hero.subtitle: Discover how easy it is to find and offer services in your own language with MinKompis

mission.title: Equal Opportunities for Everyone in Sweden
mission.description: MinKompis is a platform that enables immigrants in Sweden to access quality services by overcoming language barriers. It also empowers multilingual professionals to showcase their talents and earn income.

point1.title: Break Language Barriers
point1.description: Easily connect with trusted service providers who speak your language

point2.title: Trusted Service
point2.description: All providers are verified and rated by the community

point3.title: Community Focused
point3.description: A platform that empowers the immigrant community

story.title: How MinKompis Was Born?
story.paragraph1: As the founder of MinKompis, I vividly remember the challenges I faced when I first arrived in Sweden. Even finding a simple cleaning service became a major challenge due to the language barrier.
story.paragraph2: I realized many immigrants faced the same problem. On the other hand, there were talented professionals whose native language was Turkish, Arabic, or other languages who wanted to provide services in Sweden but couldn't reach customers.
story.paragraph3: That's when the idea of MinKompis was born. I wanted to create a platform that enables immigrants to find services in their own language and multilingual professionals to realize their potential.

milestone3.title: All of Sweden
milestone3.description: Service area expanded to all of Sweden

value1.title: Trustworthiness
value1.description: Every provider is carefully verified and reliability is continuously monitored through community reviews

value2.title: Transparency
value2.description: Clear pricing, honest reviews, and transparent communication are always our priority

value3.title: Community
value3.description: We're creating a better Sweden for everyone by empowering the immigrant community

value4.title: Security
